## Problem

`main` is red at 2e85d8558a4: `tests/unit/test_windows_text_encoding.py::test_no_src_call_decodes_child_output_with_the_locale_codec` flags `src/rebar/_opcert_gate_config.py:61`, a `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` with no `encoding=`. Every change based on current main fails `Verified` on it.

## Cause

Two changes raced. d5f10d1d2c8 (golden-busied-nag) added the call and passed CI before 37d83e8f308 (dogtired-blank-fieldmouse) added the tree-wide guard that rejects text-mode child output decoded with the locale codec. Each passed CI on its own base; their combination on main does not. Without an explicit encoding, `git show` output (the committed `rebar.toml`) is decoded with the locale code page on Windows, so a non-ASCII byte in that file would fail or mis-decode.

## Fix

Add `encoding="utf-8"` to that `subprocess.run` call, matching the guard's contract and the rest of `src/rebar`. No other behaviour changes; no new config key, env var or flag.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_opcert_gate_config.py`

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `tests/unit/test_windows_text_encoding.py` passes on the change (it fails on 2e85d8558a4).
- [x] `tests/unit/test_opcert_gate_config.py` passes on the change.
- [x] `make verify` passes on the change.
- [x] The Gerrit change merges with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
